class.name: ActInfo
class.brief_description: A resource class that stores information about enemy ACT options in battles. Contains the action name and description text displayed when the player examines or interacts with an enemy.
class.description:
[ActInfo] is a resource class used to define enemy ACT options in UT-Godot-Engine's battle system. Each ActInfo represents a single action that the player can perform on an enemy, such as "Check", "Talk", or custom interactions.
This class is typically used within [EnemyAct] resources to define what actions are available for each enemy state and what information is displayed when those actions are selected.
[b]Default Values[/b] • [member act]: "* 살펴보기" (Check action in Korean) • [member description]: "* ENEMY - ATK 1 DEF 1 \n* 정보 몰루?." (Default enemy information)
[b]Usage Example[/b] [codeblock] # Create a new ActInfo resource var act_info = ActInfo.new() act_info.act = "* Check" act_info.description = PackedStringArray([ "* FLOWEY - ATK 19 DEF 0", "* Photosynthesis." ]) [/codeblock]
[en] For a more detailed explanation, please refer to the tutorials linked below. [ko] 이것보다 더 자세한 설명(또는 한국어 문서)은 아래 링크된 튜토리얼을 참고하세요.

method.name: get_act_tr
method.description: Returns the translated version of the [member act] string. Uses Godot's translation system to return the localized text.

members.member: The name of the ACT option displayed in the battle menu. This text appears in the ACT menu when the player is choosing which action to perform. Default value is "* 살펴보기" (Korean for "Check").

member.name: description
member.default: PackedStringArray("* ENEMY - ATK 1 DEF 1 \n* 정보 몰루?.")

members.member: Array of strings containing the description text shown when this ACT option is selected. Each string in the array represents a line of dialogue or information displayed to the player. Default value provides basic enemy stats and placeholder text.
